item.g:title: Virbac Kidney Support Dog Food K1 – For Dogs with Kidney Disease 3KG
item.g:description: VETERINARY HPM® K1 Kidney Support is a complete and balanced dry food for dogs with temporary or chronic kidney disease. It’s expertly formulated to support your dog’s kidney function while helping them to maintain optimal body condition. Ideal nutrient ratios for dogs with kidney disease VETERINARY HPM® K1 Kidney Support contains a restricted amount of high-quality proteins (20.5%) to preserve lean muscle mass without adding additional strain on the kidneys. This is balanced with high energy density to give your dog the energy they need from smaller portions – ideal for periods of appetite loss. Low in phosphorous to preserve kidney function Phosphorus is an essential mineral, but in dogs with compromised kidney health they are not able to filter it effectively. VETERINARY HPM® K1 Kidney Support contains low levels of phosphorus (0.4%) to protect your dog’s kidney function. It also features chitosan, an ingredient that binds to phosphorus and reduces levels in the body. Reduces the risk of secondary health issues VETERINARY HPM® K1 Kidney Support helps to limit the risk of other health conditions associated with kidney disease. It contains: • Balanced calcium and phosphorus to protect against secondary hyperparathyroidism. • Adapted protein level to reduce production of uraemic toxins whilst maintaining body condition. • Calcium carbonate to help limit the risk of metabolic acidosis. Supportive nutrients for overall health and wellbeing VETERINARY HPM® K1 Kidney Support features a blend of ingredients designed to support your dog’s overall wellbeing: • Vitamin E is an antioxidant that helps to limit oxidative stress on the kidneys and other organs. • Omega-3 fatty acids support skin and coat health and help to limit inflammation. • Chondroitin sulphate helps to support joint cartilage health. • Chitosan optimises the breakdown and absorption of chondroitin. VETERINARY HPM® K1 Kidney Support is an ideal dog food for kidney disease in both adult and senior dogs, and is also suitable for dogs with chronic hepatic (liver) disease. Rich in naturally tasty, high-quality animal ingredients to help with palatability.

item.g:description: **PLEASE CONSULT YOUR VET BEFORE PURCHASING** Key Features/Benefits: Oligopeptides Allergen restrictions Skin barrier Antioxidants complex Royal Canin Anallergenic is formulated with feather protein hydrolysate, a protein source containing exclusively free amino acids and very low molecular weight oligopeptides. Royal Canin Anallergenic is formulated with starch instead of whole cereals and a specially designed palatability enhancer; manufactured in a production line designed to minimise contamination. Royal Canin Anallergenic contains a specially formulated complex of nutrients targeting the reduction of water loss through the skin to strengthen the barrier effect of the skin. The synergistic antioxidant complex in Royal Canin Anallergenic reduces oxidative stress and helps neutralise free radicals. Composition: Maize starch, feather hydrolysate with low molecular weight (source of L-amino acids and oligopeptides), copra oil, soya oil, minerals, vegetable fibres, chicory pulp, Fructo- Oligo-Saccharides (FOS), fish oil, mono- and diglycerides of fatty acids esterified with citric acid, animal fat, marigold extract (source of lutein). Additives (per KG): Nutritional additives: Vitamin A: 30600IU, Vitamin D3: 800IU, E1 (Iron): 42mg, E2 (Iodine): 3.7mg, E4 (Copper): 13mg, E5 (Manganese): 55mg, E6 (Zinc): 198mg, E8 (Selenium): 0.1mg. item.g:title: INABA Churu Tuna with Scallop Recipe x4 pcs
item.g:description: INABA Churu Tuna with Scallop Recipe x4 pcs INGREDIENTS: Water, Tuna, Tapioca Starch, Scallop, Natural Scallop Flavor, Natural Flavors, Guar Gum, Vitamin E Supplement, Taurine, Green Tea Extract GUARANTEED ANALYSIS: Crude Protein(min) 7.00% Crude Fat (min) 0.20% Crude Fiber (max) 0.30% Moisture (max) 91.00% Vitamin E (min) 310 IU/kg Taurine (min) 0.025% CALORIE CONTENT: 430kcal/kg, 6.0kcal/tube ME Here at Inaba, we know your cat is a beloved family member. That’s why each of our Churu Lickable Creamy Purée Natural Cat Treats is made from high-quality ingredients, including wild-caught tuna and farm-raised chicken. Since cats are not naturally drawn to water, we have made these a high-moisture, low-calorie cat treat that your kitties will love. They contain 91% moisture and have only six calories per tube. That’s a tenth of the calories of traditional dry cat treats and more than 1000 times the moisture (8% vs. 91% moisture). In addition, we’ve also added Taurine to help with their vision, digestion, and heart health, as well as Vitamin E for immunity and Green Tea Extract for its natural antioxidants. What they’re missing? They’re grain-free, preservative-free, carrageenan-free, and free from artificial colors, making them a cat treat you can feel good about feeding. Designed to be hand fed, you can use it to help calm the feistiest of outdoor ferals or treat your pampered indoor pussycat. They can be used as a dry/canned cat food topper or to assist with giving medications. Available in 19 savory flavors, you’ll be able to find a flavor that your kitty will crave no matter what stage of life they are (kitten to senior). Inaba Churu makes snack time fun for you and your feline friends. MADE WITH WHOLESOME INGREDIENTS YOU CAN TRUST : Every Inaba product is made with yummy high-quality ingredients, including farm-raised chicken and/or natural wild-caught tuna KEEP YOUR FELINE HYDRATED WITHOUT ADDING CALORIES: Each delicious, creamy Churu tube contains 91% moisture and only six calories (a tenth of the calories of traditional dry cat treats), which makes it a healthy snack you can feel good about feeding FREE OF THE BAD STUFF : Your feline friend is important to us, which is why we’ve kept things like grains, preservatives, artificial colors, and carrageenan out of our cat treats, but we added things like Taurine to help with their overall health HAVE THEM EATING OUT OF YOUR HAND : These lickable purée meat tubes for cats were designed to be fed by hand as an interactive way to spend time with your feline, but you can use them as a wet/dry cat food topper or as a way to disguise medication ADD SOME VARIETY TO YOUR CAT’S LIFE : Available in nineteen savory flavors, cats of all stages (kitten to senior) will be able to find a flavor they love Feeding Instructions Feed as a treat to your cat. This product is not intended to be fed as a meal. Provide clean, fresh water daily. For your pet’s health, see your veterinarian regularly. Storage Instructions Refrigerate after opening and serve as soon as possible.

Product Details & Features This 4-ball set is designed with your cat’s fun and your home’s harmony in mind: Contents: 4 balls (assorted colours) in one set. Material / Durability: Lightweight foam or soft rubber-blend materials suitable for batting, rolling and indoor chase. Best For: Indoor cats, kittens, multi-cat homes or anyone looking to enrich their cat’s toy rotation. Special Features: Bright colours catch your cat’s eye and invite play. Small-enough size for chasing and batting in confined indoor spaces. Low-risk for furniture or décor — designed to keep play safe and fun. Usage Scenarios: Toss one ball for a quick chase session in a corridor or living room. Leave balls around accessible areas so your cat can self-entertain when you’re busy. Rotate the balls to keep novelty high and avoid boredom. Specifications & Use Feature Detail Pack size 4 balls Size/Dimensions Approximate (see listing) – often ~3.5 cm diameter for small indoor version Material Lightweight foam or soft rubber-blend Ideal use Indoor chase, batting, rolling, self-play Recommended for Kittens, indoor cats, multi-cat households How to use: Remove any packaging and present the ball to your cat — allow sniffing and interest-building. Roll or toss the ball to spark chasing behaviour; encourage batting with paws or chasing after it. For independent play, leave a couple of the balls in safe zones where your cat can access them. Inspect the balls regularly for any damage, cracks or pieces coming loose — remove if worn to preserve safety. Store the balls in a toy box or basket to keep them distinct and ready for play.

item.g:title: IMac Dea Food Dispenser for Pet Red / 3L (33.5*24*29.5 Cm)
item.g:description: IMac Dea Food Dispenser for Pets The feeding station that works while you don't. The IMac Dea Food Dispenser brings the clean, considered design of the Dea range to a fully functional gravity-fed dispenser — a reservoir unit that automatically releases food into the bowl as your pet eats, keeping the feeding station consistently stocked without constant manual refilling. Available in Blue and Red, in 1.5L and 3L capacities, the Dea Dispenser is the practical, beautiful solution for busy households, free-feeding routines, and owners who want the confidence that their pet always has food available — in a unit that looks as intentional as everything else in their home. Why IMac Dea Food Dispenser Is the Best Choice Gravity-fed auto-refill mechanism — as your pet eats from the bowl, food flows down from the reservoir automatically, maintaining a consistent level without any manual intervention between fills Italian Dea design language — the same clean, rounded aesthetic that defines the Dea range, now in a full dispenser format; functional and beautiful in equal measure Available in Blue and Red — two bold color options to suit your home's aesthetic or to differentiate dispensers in multi-pet households 1.5L and 3L reservoir capacities — the 1.5L suits cats and small dogs with 1–2 days of food between fills; the 3L handles larger dogs or multi-day free-feeding routines No batteries or electronics — the gravity mechanism is passive, reliable, and maintenance-free; nothing to charge, replace, or repair Transparent reservoir section — allows easy visual monitoring of food levels without opening or moving the unit Stable, wide-base design — the dispenser's footprint and low center of gravity keep it stable even during enthusiastic feeding Suitable for both cats and dogs — the dispenser format works across species and feeding styles Product Details & Features The Dea Food Dispenser operates on the same reliable gravity principle as the Ciottoli Dispenser — food stored in an upper reservoir flows down by gravity into the bowl below as the bowl empties. The mechanism is entirely passive: no batteries, no electronics, no moving parts. It works continuously and silently, requiring attention only when the reservoir needs refilling. What distinguishes the Dea Dispenser from the Ciottoli Dispenser is the design language. Where the Ciottoli range is defined by its smooth, pebble-inspired rounded form, the Dea range has its own distinct aesthetic identity — and the Dea Dispenser maintains that identity in a full-height dispenser format. The result is a feeding station that integrates naturally into a home environment as a considered design object rather than a purely utilitarian appliance. The color options — Blue and Red — add a further dimension of personalization that the Ciottoli Dispenser (available in a single colorway) doesn't offer. For multi-pet households where visual differentiation between feeding stations is useful, or simply for owners who want their pet's feeding area to reflect a specific color palette, the Dea Dispenser provides that flexibility. The 1.5L capacity (26×18.5×24cm) is well-suited to cats and small dogs — providing 1–2 days of free-feeding capacity for most cats, or a full day's portion for small breeds. The 3L capacity (33.5×24×29.5cm) scales up for medium-to-large dogs or multi-cat households where a larger reserve between fills is more practical. Key Features: Gravity-fed auto-refill mechanism — no batteries or electronics required Italian Dea design — clean, rounded aesthetic in Blue and Red 2 sizes: 1.5L and 3L reservoir capacity Transparent reservoir for easy food level monitoring Wide, stable base — anti-tip design Smooth interior surfaces — easy to clean Suitable for cats and dogs Ideal for free-feeding, busy households, and short trips Cats and small dogs (up to 8 kg) — the 1.5L provides 1–2 days of free-feeding capacity for most cats, or a full day's portion for small breeds Medium-to-large dogs and multi-cat households — the 3L reduces refill frequency significantly, making it the practical choice for larger pets or busier routines

item.g:title: Perfecto Cat 10X Catsticks Mit Kaninchen & Geflugel 50g
item.g:description: Perfecto Cat — Catsticks Mit Kaninchen & Geflügel (Rabbit & Poultry) | 10 Sticks × 5g | 50g | Premium Cat Treat The most ancestrally authentic treat in the Perfecto Cat range. Catsticks Mit Kaninchen & Geflügel brings together rabbit — the protein that most closely resembles the ancestral feline prey diet — and poultry as the universally appealing, familiar base, in the satisfying chewy stick format that cats hold, chew, and devour with natural instinct. Rabbit is the rarest and most nutritionally exceptional protein in commercial cat food — genuinely novel for virtually every domestic cat, exceptionally lean, exceptionally digestible, and the protein that cats are most biologically designed to eat. Poultry provides the familiar palatability foundation that ensures the formula is accepted enthusiastically even by cats encountering rabbit for the first time. Together, they create the most biologically appropriate and nutritionally distinctive treat in the Perfecto Cat range — 10 individual sticks of German quality, in the protein combination that nature intended. 50g per pack — the ancestral treat for the modern cat. Why Perfecto Cat Catsticks Rabbit & Poultry Is The Best Choice Rabbit — The Most Ancestrally Authentic Protein — Rabbit is the protein that most closely resembles the small prey that cats evolved to hunt — the most biologically appropriate protein available in commercial cat food. Genuinely Novel Protein — Virtually no domestic cat has ever eaten rabbit — making this the most novel protein available in the Perfecto Cat range, ideal for cats with sensitivities to common proteins or who need dietary variety. Exceptionally Lean — Rabbit is one of the leanest animal proteins available — lower in fat than chicken, turkey, or beef — ideal for cats who need high-quality protein without excessive caloric density. Exceptionally Digestible — Rabbit's fine muscle fiber structure makes it one of the most digestible proteins available — maximizing nutrient absorption and minimizing digestive stress. Poultry — The Familiar Foundation — The universally appealing poultry base that provides complete protein, natural taurine, and the familiar palatability that ensures the formula is accepted even by cats encountering rabbit for the first time. Dual Novel + Familiar Protein — Rabbit's novelty and poultry's familiarity create the ideal introduction to novel protein feeding — the cat accepts the familiar poultry while being exposed to the nutritional benefits of rabbit. Natural Taurine from Both Proteins — Both rabbit and poultry are natural taurine sources — the essential amino acid cats cannot synthesize. 10 Individual Sticks — Pre-portioned into 10 individual sticks of ~5g each — perfect daily portion control. Stick Format — The elongated stick format that cats hold between their paws and chew — engaging natural holding and chewing behaviors. German Quality — Perfecto Cat — A trusted German pet food brand with rigorous quality standards. (Visual asset placement: lifestyle photo of a cat holding and chewing a Perfecto Cat stick, or flat-lay of the 10 sticks fanned out from the pack.) Product Details & Features Rabbit — The Ancestral Feline Protein Rabbit is the most significant and distinctive ingredient in this formula — and understanding why rabbit is so exceptional for cats explains why this is the most nutritionally meaningful treat in the Perfecto Cat range. The ancestral diet connection: Domestic cats ( Felis catus ) evolved from the African wildcat ( Felis silvestris lybica ) — a small predator whose natural prey consisted primarily of small mammals (mice, rats, rabbits, hares) and birds. Rabbit and hare were a significant component of the ancestral feline diet — making rabbit the protein that cats are most biologically designed to eat. The nutritional profile of rabbit closely matches the nutritional requirements that feline physiology evolved around: High protein, low fat — matching the lean muscle of small prey Complete amino acid profile — all essential amino acids in proportions that match feline requirements Natural taurine — the essential amino acid that cats evolved to obtain from prey meat Low carbohydrate — matching the near-zero carbohydrate content of whole prey Why rabbit is rare in commercial cat food: Despite being the most biologically appropriate protein for cats, rabbit is rare in commercial cat food — the result of: Higher ingredient cost compared to chicken, tuna, or beef Lower supply chain availability and scalability Less consumer familiarity in most markets Its inclusion in Perfecto Cat Catsticks reflects a genuine commitment to premium ingredient quality — and makes this the most nutritionally distinctive treat in the range. Nutritional profile of rabbit: Exceptionally lean: Rabbit is one of the leanest animal proteins available — leaner than chicken breast, turkey, or any common cat food protein: Protein Fat Content (per 100g) Rabbit ~3–5g Chicken breast ~3–4g Turkey ~4–5g Beef ~15–

item.g:title: Virbac Cat Advanced Kidney & Joint 3KG
item.g:description: Virbac HPM — Cat Advanced Kidney & Joint The senior cat clinical diet that addresses both conditions at once. Virbac HPM Cat Advanced Kidney & Joint is a veterinary clinical nutrition dry cat food specifically formulated for the two most prevalent and frequently co-occurring conditions in senior cats — chronic kidney disease (CKD) and joint disease (osteoarthritis). These conditions are not coincidental companions — they share common risk factors, common inflammatory mechanisms, and common patient demographics. The senior cat who develops CKD is the same cat who develops joint disease — and managing one condition while ignoring the other produces incomplete clinical outcomes. Virbac HPM addresses both simultaneously through a precisely calibrated nutritional strategy that navigates the most challenging tension in feline clinical nutrition: kidney diets require controlled protein to reduce renal workload, but joint disease requires adequate protein to maintain the lean muscle mass that supports joint function and mobility. Virbac HPM Cat Advanced Kidney & Joint resolves this tension through high-quality, highly digestible protein at precisely controlled levels — providing adequate amino acids for muscle maintenance while minimizing the uremic toxin load on compromised kidneys. Available in 400g (trial size) and 1.5kg. Why Virbac HPM Cat Advanced Kidney & Joint Is The Best Choice Dual Clinical Indication — Simultaneously addresses chronic kidney disease (CKD) and joint disease (osteoarthritis) — the two most prevalent co-occurring conditions in senior cats. Controlled High-Quality Protein — The most clinically precise aspect of the formula — protein is controlled to reduce renal workload while remaining adequate for lean muscle maintenance that supports joint function. Phosphorus Restriction — Reduced phosphorus is the single most important dietary intervention for slowing CKD progression — the Virbac HPM formula provides clinically appropriate phosphorus restriction. Omega-3 (EPA & DHA) — Dual Benefit — Omega-3 fatty acids provide anti-inflammatory benefit for both kidney disease (reducing renal inflammation) and joint disease (reducing synovial inflammation and cartilage degradation). Joint Support Nutrients — Glucosamine and chondroitin sulfate supporting cartilage integrity and synovial fluid quality — the structural joint support nutrients that reduce pain and improve mobility. Antioxidants — Renal & Joint Protection — Vitamins E and C, selenium — reducing oxidative stress that accelerates both kidney damage and cartilage degradation. Alkalizing Effect — Metabolic acidosis is a common complication of CKD — the formula's alkalizing effect supports acid-base balance and reduces the muscle wasting that acidosis causes. High Palatability — Clinical diets are only effective if the cat eats them — the Virbac HPM formula is formulated for high palatability to ensure consistent consumption by cats who may have reduced appetite secondary to CKD. Two Sizes — 400g trial size for initial introduction; 1.5kg for ongoing management. Virbac HPM — Veterinary Expertise — From one of the world's leading animal health companies. (Visual asset placement: flat-lay of both the 400g and 1.5kg Virbac HPM bags, or lifestyle photo of a comfortable senior cat — communicating the quality of life that effective clinical management supports.) item.g:title: Royal Canin Persian Adult Dry Food – (1+ Year Old) 4KG
item.g:description: The Persian cat has the longest and densest coat of all cat breeds. This means that it typically needs to consume more skin-health focused nutrients than other cat breeds. That’s why ROYAL CANIN® Persian Adult contains an exclusive complex of nutrients to help the skin’s barrier defence role to maintain good skin and coat health. Due to their long fur, Persian cats are prone to the formation of hairballs, which can cause discomfort. However, thanks to ROYAL CANIN® Persian Adult, loose ingested hair is eliminated, hairball formation is controlled and intestinal transit is naturally stimulated through a specific blend of fibres (including psyllium rich in mucilage). Digestive performance is also maintained through low indigestible proteins (L.I.P), prebiotics and omega 3 & 6 fatty acids. Not only this, but ROYAL CANIN® Persian Adult’s tailor-made kibble is almond shaped with an optimal contact surface area – making it easy for Persian cats to pick up and chew. To cater to each cat’s individual preferences, ROYAL CANIN® Persian Adult is also available as wet food in a soft and tasty loaf. If you’re considering mixed feeding, simply follow our feeding guidelines to ensure your cat gets an accurate amount of both wet and dry food for optimal benefit. Key Benefits: Long hair health Hairball reduction Digestive performance Composition: Dehydrated poultry protein, animal fats, rice, vegetable protein isolate*, maize flour, vegetable fibres, hydrolyzed animal proteins, maize gluten wheat flour, maize, yeasts and parts thereof, minerals, chicory pulp, fish oil, psyllium husks and seeds (1%), soya oil, fructo-oligo-saccharides, hydrolyzed yeast (source of manno-oligo-saccharides), borage oil,marigold extract (source of lutein) L.I.P.: protein selected for its very high digestivity Additives: Vitamin A: 31000 IU, Vitamin D3: 800 IU, E1 (Iron): 36 mg, E2 (Iodine): 3.6 mg, E4 (Copper):11 mg, E5 (Manganese): 47 mg, E6 (Zinc): 140 mg, E8(Selenium): 0.08 mg- Technological additives: Clinoptilolite of sedimentary origin: 10 g – Preservatives - Antioxidants Analytical Constituents: Protein: 30 % Fat content: 22% Crude fibers: 4.7 % Crude ash: 7.4% Disclaimer: The product images have been prepared for information purposes only, and are designed to enhance your shopping experience on the website, it is not a substitute for you reading the product packaging and label prior to use. item.g:description: Taste of the Wild Pacific Stream Grain-Free Dog Food 5.6kg Taste of the wild Pacific Stream Canine Recipe is formulated to meet the nutritional levels established by the AAFCO Dog Food Nutrient Profiles for maintenance. This egg-free recipe gets all its animal protein from fish, meaning that it’s rich in the omega fatty acids that help keep skin healthy and fur smooth and shiny, and may be a good option for dogs with food sensitivities. The sustainably sourced, smoked salmon taste will satisfy any dog’s inner-wolf while meticulously selected ingredients provide the ideal nutrient levels for the overall health and vitality of adult dogs. Sustainably Sourced Salmon – Salmon, the number one ingredient in this formula, provides high-quality protein and omega fatty acids for skin and coat health. To help promote sustainable fishing, we use a blend of wild-caught and farmed salmon. Species Specific Probiotics – Healthy digestive and immune systems are vital to the overall health of your pet. Our proprietary K9 Strain Probiotics are developed specifically for dogs and added after the cooking process to ensure viability. Each pound of Taste of the Wild provides 80 million live, active cultures that help support healthy digestive and immune systems. Ideal For Adult Dogs – This recipe is specifically designed to provide complete nutrition and help maintain the sleek condition of good health for your adult dog. Egg-Free – This formula is made without eggs or egg products, which may be suitable for dogs who have a sensitivity to eggs. Dried Chicory Root – This source of prebiotic fibre provides fuel for the beneficial probiotic bacteria in the digestive system. Antioxidants – Vegetables, legumes and fruits, including sweet potatoes, tomatoes, blueberries and raspberries, provide nutrients that help support your dog’s overall well-being while guaranteed levels of zinc, selenium and vitamin E support the immune system.

Product Details & Features Liver — The Most Nutritionally Dense Ingredient in Cat Food Liver is the defining ingredient of this formula — and understanding why liver is so nutritionally exceptional explains why this is the most micronutrient-rich treat in the Perfecto Cat range. What liver is: Liver is an organ meat — the primary metabolic organ of the animal, responsible for processing nutrients, filtering toxins, and producing essential compounds. Because the liver is the site of nutrient processing and storage, it accumulates extraordinarily high concentrations of vitamins and minerals — making it the most nutrient-dense food available in the animal kingdom. Why liver is exceptional for cats: Vitamin A — The Critical Feline Distinction: Liver's most important nutritional contribution for cats is preformed Vitamin A (retinol) — and this is where cats differ fundamentally from dogs and humans: Cats cannot convert beta-carotene to Vitamin A — Unlike dogs and humans, cats lack the enzyme (beta-carotene dioxygenase) required to convert plant-derived beta-carotene into Vitamin A. They must obtain preformed Vitamin A (retinol) directly from animal sources. Liver is the richest natural source of preformed Vitamin A — Liver contains more preformed Vitamin A per gram than any other food — making it the most important dietary source of this essential vitamin for cats. item.g:title: Virbac Puppy Small & Toy 3KG
item.g:description: Virbac HPM — Puppy Small & Toy | Veterinary-Grade Dry Puppy Food The foundation of a healthy small breed life. Virbac HPM Puppy Small & Toy is a veterinary-grade growth diet specifically formulated for the unique nutritional requirements of small and toy breed puppies — the breeds whose rapid early development, high metabolic rate, and small stomach capacity demand a fundamentally different nutritional approach from medium and large breed puppy foods. Small and toy breed puppies are not simply smaller versions of large breed puppies — they grow faster relative to their adult size, reach maturity earlier, burn more calories per kilogram of body weight, and have smaller mouths and stomachs that require smaller kibble and higher energy density per gram of food. Virbac HPM Puppy Small & Toy is formulated to address every one of these specific requirements — high energy density for the small breed metabolic rate, optimal protein for rapid muscle and organ development, precise calcium and phosphorus ratios for small breed skeletal development, DHA for brain and vision development, and a kibble size designed for small mouths. Veterinary-grade nutrition from Virbac — the animal health company that applies pharmaceutical-grade scientific rigor to every product it produces. 3kg — the growth diet that gives small breed puppies the nutritional foundation they deserve. Why Virbac HPM Puppy Small & Toy Is The Best Choice Small & Toy Breed Specific — Formulated specifically for the unique metabolic, developmental, and physical requirements of small and toy breed puppies — not a generic puppy food adapted for small breeds. High Energy Density — Small and toy breed puppies have a metabolic rate 2–3× higher per kilogram than large breeds — the high energy density formula meets this elevated caloric requirement in the small portions their stomachs can accommodate. Optimal Protein for Rapid Development — High-quality protein supporting the rapid muscle, organ, and tissue development that characterizes the small breed growth phase. Precise Calcium & Phosphorus Ratios — Carefully calibrated calcium and phosphorus levels for small breed skeletal development — avoiding the over-supplementation that can cause developmental orthopedic disease. DHA for Brain & Vision Development — Docosahexaenoic acid (DHA) is the critical Omega-3 for neurological and retinal development — supporting cognitive development and visual acuity during the critical early growth phase. Small Kibble Size — Kibble sized for small mouths and developing teeth — ensuring comfortable eating and adequate chewing for small and toy breed puppies. Immune System Support — Antioxidants and immune-supporting nutrients for the developing immune system of growing puppies. Digestive Support — Highly digestible ingredients and prebiotic fiber supporting the sensitive digestive system of small breed puppies. item.g:description: Details Wet food for dogs Complete feed for dogs - For adult dogs over 10 months old - Dogs prone to digestive sensitivity. PRODUCT DETAILS Digestive sensitivities in dogs can often be identified by the consistency and frequency of their stools. Larger dogs with upset stomachs tend to produce runnier stools at a higher frequency, while smaller dogs tend to experience constipation and produce more solid stools. A wide variety of different factors can influence digestive sensitivities in dogs, including age, weight, and breed. But with the right diet, your dog can benefit from nutrients that help to support healthy digestion. ROYAL CANIN® Digestive Care Loaf is a precisely balanced nutritional formula that is specifically created to support healthier digestion in dogs with digestive sensitivities. This food is suitable for dogs of all breeds, shapes and sizes. A diet that is too varied can result in further digestive issues and upset the balance of the good bacteria, or 'microflora' , in your dog's gut. Microflora encourages a healthy digestive environment and can be supported by the right diet containing the right nutrients. This food contains specially selected nutrients that are highly digestible and easy to absorb. The exclusive blend of fibres, prebiotics and protein in this product help to facilitate a good digestive environment that supports healthy digestion. Composition: Meat and animal derivatives, cereals, derivatives of vegetable origin, minerals. Additives (per kg): Nutritional additives: Vitamin D3: 170 IU, Iron (3b103): 5 mg, Iodine (3b202): 0.25 mg, Copper (3b405, 3b406): 2 mg, Manganese (3b502, 3b503, 3b504): 1.5 mg, Zinc (3b603, 3b605, 3b606): 15 mg - Technological additives: Clinoptilolite of sedimentary origin: 2.2 g. Analytical constituents: Protein: 8.6% - Crude fibres: 1.3% - Fat content: 5.8% - Crude ash: 1.8% - Moisture: 78.9%.

item.g:title: Royal Canin Hairball Care Dry Food – (Hairball Prevention, Adult Cats) 2KG
item.g:description: Cats often spend large parts of its day self-grooming, and can therefore swallow large quantities of hair. This ingested hair can become compacted in the digestive tract, resulting in the formation of hairballs which are then either regurgitated or eliminated through its faces. ROYAL CANIN® Hairball Care is composed of a specific blend of dietary fibres, including psyllium (rich in mucilage) and insoluble fibres to help naturally stimulate healthy intestinal transit. As a result, hair swallowed daily can be eliminated in its faeces rather than building up in the stomach and being regurgitated. ROYAL CANIN® Hairball Care contains a precise combination of nutrients with a high protein content (34%) and a high fat content (15%) to ensure that a healthy level of nutrients is maintained effectively. ROYAL CANIN® Hairball Care has been proven to eliminate twice as much excess hair in a cat’s body after just 14 days of feeding. To cater to each cat’s individual preferences, ROYAL CANIN® Hairball Care is also available as wet food in delicious gravy. If you’re considering mixed feeding, simply follow our feeding guidelines to ensure your cat gets an accurate amount of both wet and dry food for optimal benefit. Key Benefits: Reduces hairball formation Eliminates swallowed hair Healthy digestive system Composition: Dehydrated poultry vegetable protein, vegetable protein isolate*, maize, vegetable fibres, rice, animal fats, hydrolyzed animal proteins, wheat, maize flour, maize gluten, beet pulp, yeasts and parts thereof, minerals, soya oil, fish oil,fructo-oligo-saccharides, psyllium husks and seeds (0.5%). L.I.P: protein selected for its very high digestibility. Additives (per KG): Nutritional additives: Vitamin A: 25000 IU, Vitamin D3: 1000 IU, E1(Iron): 32 mg, E2(Iodine): 3.2 mg, E4(Copper): 10 mg, E5(Manganese): 42 mg, E6(Zinc): 88 mg, E8(Selenium): 0.05 mg – Preservatives – Antioxidants. item.g:title: Nexgard Afoxolaner Chewable 136mg Tablets for Large Dogs (25-50kg)
item.g:description: NexGard Chewable Tablets for Dogs (25–50 kg) Active Ingredient: Afoxolaner 136 mg Pack Size: 1 Chewable Tablet Product Description Protect your dog with NexGard Chewable Tablets , a trusted monthly oral treatment specially formulated for dogs weighing 25–50 kg . Each beef-flavored chew contains Afoxolaner to provide fast, effective protection against fleas and ticks, helping keep your dog healthy, active, and comfortable throughout the month. Key Benefits Fast-Acting Formula: Starts killing fleas quickly after administration. Reliable Tick Protection: Helps treat and control common tick infestations. Easy to Administer: Beef-flavored chew that most dogs readily accept. No Mess: Oral treatment leaves no residue on your dog's coat. Monthly Protection: One chew provides up to 30 days of flea and tick protection. Bath & Groom Friendly: Bathing, swimming, or grooming will not affect product performance. Directions for Use Give one chewable tablet orally once every month , or as directed by your veterinarian. Intended for dogs weighing between 25 kg and 50 kg . Can be administered with or without food . Make sure your dog consumes the entire tablet. Safety Information For dogs only . Do not use in cats or other animal species. Keep out of reach of children. Consult your veterinarian before use if your dog has a history of seizures or neurological disorders. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. أقراص نيكس جارد القابلة للمضغ للكلاب (25–50 كجم) المادة الفعالة: أفوكسولانر 136 مجم حجم العبوة: قرص مضغ واحد وصف المنتج وفّر لكلبك حماية شهرية موثوقة مع نيكس جارد أقراص المضغ ، وهو علاج فموي مصمم خصيصًا للكلاب التي يتراوح وزنها بين 25 و50 كجم . يحتوي كل قرص بنكهة اللحم على أفوكسولانر لتوفير حماية سريعة وفعالة ضد البراغيث والقراد، مما يساعد في الحفاظ على صحة كلبك ونشاطه وراحته طوال الشهر. أهم المميزات مفعول سريع: يبدأ في القضاء على البراغيث خلال وقت قصير بعد الاستخدام. حماية فعالة من القراد: يساعد في مكافحة والسيطرة على أكثر أنواع القراد شيوعًا. سهل التقديم: قرص مضغ بنكهة اللحم تقبله معظم الكلاب بسهولة. بدون فوضى: علاج فموي لا يترك أي بقايا أو ملمس دهني على الفراء. حماية لمدة شهر كامل: قرص واحد يوفر حماية مستمرة لمدة تصل إلى 30 يومًا. لا يتأثر بالاستحمام أو السباحة: يمكن استحمام أو تنظيف الكلب دون التأثير على فعالية المنتج. طريقة الاستخدام يُعطى قرص واحد عن طريق الفم مرة كل شهر أو حسب تعليمات الطبيب البيطري. مخصص للكلاب التي يتراوح وزنها بين 25 و50 كجم . يمكن إعطاؤه مع الطعام أو بدونه . تأكد من تناول الكلب للقرص بالكامل للحصول على الجرعة المناسبة. معلومات السلامة للاستخدام في الكلاب فقط . لا يُستخدم للقطط أو أي حيوانات أخرى. يُحفظ بعيدًا عن متناول الأطفال. استشر الطبيب البيطري قبل الاستخدام إذا كان الكلب يعاني من تاريخ مرضي يتعلق بالتشنجات أو الاضطرابات العصبية. يُحفظ في مكان بارد وجاف بعيدًا عن أشعة الشمس المباشرة.

item.g:title: Royal Canin Hepatic (420 gm) – Wet food exclusively formulated to support dogs suffering with liver disease
item.g:description: PLEASE CONSULT YOUR VET BEFORE PURCHASING** ROYAL CANIN® Hepatic is exclusively formulated to support dogs suffering with liver disease, thanks to a variety of helpful nutrients. This tailor-made diet contains specially adapted, high-quality proteins. In cases of chronic liver insufficiency, these carefully selected proteins help to support your dog’s liver function. Copper accumulation can happen in some liver diseases, and ROYAL CANIN® Hepatic Loaf’s low copper content can therefore help minimising copper accumulation in your dog’s liver Maintaining your dog’s energy levels is important, as this also contributes to healthy liver function. This exclusive diet boasts a high energy content to help maintain your dog’s energy intake. As part of the ROYAL CANIN® Veterinary Range, it is important that this product is only given to your pet when recommended by a veterinary professional. Composition: cereals, meat and animal derivatives, derivatives of vegetable origin, oils and fats, minerals, various sugars. Protein sources: Poultry by-products. Highly digestible carbohydrates: rice, maize flour. Additives (per kg): Nutritional additives: Vitamin D3: 300 IU, Iron (3b103): 13 mg, Iodine (3b202): 0.7 mg, Copper (3b405, 3b406): 0.8 mg, Manganese (3b502, 3b503, 3b504): 5.8 mg, Zinc (3b603, 3b605, 3b606): 24 mg, Selenium (3b801, 3b811): 0.039 mg. Analytical constituents: Protein: 6.5%, Fat content: 4.0%, Crude ash: 1.7%, Crude fibres: 1.0%, Moisture: 64.5%, Essential Fatty acids (Linoleic Acid): 1.3%, Sodium: 0.08%, Total copper: 1.7 mg/kg. Feeding instructions: see table. Water should be available at all times. To be stored in a cool, dry place. THE BENEFITS ADAPTED PROTEIN CONTENT : Adapted levels of highly digestible vegetable proteins to support liver function in case of chronic liver insufficiency. LOW COPPER : Low level of copper to help minimise its accumulation in liver cells. HIGH ENERGY : A high energy content to reduce meal volume and decrease intestinal load. Disclaimer: The product images have been prepared for information purposes only, and are designed to enhance your shopping experience on the website, it is not a substitute for you reading the product packaging and label prior to use. You should note that products and their ingredients are subject to change. If you do require precise ingredient information you should consult the manufacturer. ** يرجى استشارة الطبيب البيطري قبل الشراء ** تم تصميم ROYAL CANIN® Hepatic حصريًا لدعم الكلاب التي تعاني من أمراض الكبد ، وذلك بفضل مجموعة متنوعة من العناصر الغذائية المفيدة. يحتوي هذا النظام الغذائي المصمم خصيصًا على بروتينات عالية الجودة ومكيفة بشكل خاص. في حالات قصور الكبد المزمن ، تساعد هذه البروتينات المختارة بعناية في دعم وظيفة الكبد لدى كلبك. يمكن أن يحدث تراكم النحاس في بعض أمراض الكبد ، وبالتالي يمكن أن يساعد محتوى النحاس المنخفض في ROYAL CANIN® Hepatic Loaf في تقليل تراكم النحاس في كبد كلبك ، يعد الحفاظ على مستويات طاقة الكلب أمرًا مهمًا ، لأن هذا يساهم أيضًا في وظائف الكبد الصحية. يحتوي هذا النظام الغذائي الحصري على نسبة عالية من الطاقة للمساعدة في الحفاظ على استهلاك الكلب للطاقة. كجزء من مجموعة ROYAL CANIN® البيطرية ، من المهم أن يتم إعطاء هذا المنتج لحيوانك الأليف فقط عندما يوصي به أخصائي بيطري. التركيب: الحبوب واللحوم ومشتقاتها الحيوانية ومشتقاتها النباتية والزيوت والدهون والمعادن والسكريات المختلفة. مصادر البروتين: مشتقات الدواجن. كربوهيدرات عالية الهضم: الأرز ودقيق الذرة. الإضافات (لكل كيلوغرام): المضافات الغذائية: فيتامين د 3: 300 وحدة دولية ، حديد (3 ب103): 13 مجم ، اليود (3 ب 202): 0.7 مجم ، نحاس (3 ب 405 ، 3 ب 406): 0.8 مجم ، منجنيز (3 ب 502 ، 3 ب 503 ، 3 ب 504): 5.8 ملغ ، زنك (3b603 ، 3b605 ، 3b606): 24 ملغ ، سيلينيوم (3b801 ، 3b811): 0.039 ملغ. المكونات التحليلية: بروتين: 6.5٪ ، محتوى دهون: 4.0٪ ، رماد خام: 1.7٪ ، ألياف خام: 1.0٪ ، رطوبة: 64.5٪ ، أحماض دهنية أساسية (حمض اللينوليك): 1.3٪ ، صوديوم: 0.08٪ ، إجمالي النحاس: 1.7 مجم / كجم. تعليمات التغذية: انظر الجدول. يجب أن تكون المياه متوفرة في جميع الأوقات. يحفظ في مكان بارد وجاف. الفوائد محتوى البروتين المعدل: مستويات معدلة من البروتينات النباتية عالية الهضم لدعم وظائف الكبد في حالة قصور الكبد المزمن. انخفاض النحاس: مستوى منخفض من النحاس للمساعدة في تقليل تراكمه في خلايا الكبد. طاقة عالية: محتوى مرتفع من الطاقة لتقليل حجم الوجبة وتقليل الحمل المعوي. اخلاء المسؤوليه : تم اعداد صور المنتج لأغراض المعلومات فقط ، وهي مصممه لتعزيز تجربه التسوق الخاصة بك علي الموقع ، فانه ليس بديلا ل قراءه المنتج التعبئة والتغليف والتسمية قبل الاستخدام. يجب ان نلاحظ ان المنتجات والمكونات الخاصة بهم عرضه للتغيير. إذا كنت لا تتطلب معلومات دقيقه المكون يجب عليك استشاره الشركة المصنعة

item.g:title: BELCANDO® ADULT GF OCEAN 4kg
item.g:description: Description: Treat your dog to the natural goodness of the sea with BELCANDO® Adult GF Ocean 4kg , a premium grain-free dry dog food specially formulated for adult dogs. Made with high-quality fish such as salmon and herring , this nutritious meal is packed with protein, healthy fats, and essential nutrients, promoting overall health and well-being. Perfect for adult dogs with grain sensitivities or food allergies, this formula offers a delicious, easily digestible alternative to traditional dog food. BELCANDO® Adult GF Ocean provides omega-3 and omega-6 fatty acids , which support healthy skin, a glossy coat, and cognitive function. With a blend of vegetables , fruits , and herbs , this wholesome recipe offers a balanced meal that aids digestion, boosts energy, and supports a strong immune system. Free from grains, gluten, and artificial additives, this food ensures your dog gets only the best, most natural nutrition. Key Features: 🐾 Grain-Free Formula : Perfect for dogs with grain sensitivities or allergies, providing a healthy, easily digestible meal. Premium Fish Protein : Salmon and herring as the primary protein sources, supporting muscle development, energy, and a healthy immune system. Omega Fatty Acids : Omega-3 and omega-6 fatty acids promote a healthy coat, smooth skin, and improved brain function. Digestible and Wholesome Ingredients : A combination of fruits, vegetables, and herbs to support healthy digestion and provide essential vitamins and minerals. No Artificial Additives : Free from artificial colors, flavors, and preservatives, ensuring a natural, nutrient-packed diet. Why Choose BELCANDO® Adult GF Ocean 4kg? 🐾 Ideal for adult dogs with grain sensitivities or those on a grain-free diet. Supports strong muscles, a healthy coat, and overall vitality with high-quality fish protein. Promotes healthy skin, shiny fur, and brain function with omega fatty acids. A complete and balanced formula that provides everything your adult dog needs for optimal health. Give your dog the best of the ocean with BELCANDO® Adult GF Ocean 4kg – a delicious and nutritious grain-free meal that supports your dog’s health, energy, and happiness. Ratio of animal protein to total protein: 75 % (from sea fish 65 %, from marine zooplankton/ krill 10 %) الوصف: 🐾 دلل كلبك بالخير الطبيعي للبحر مع طعام BELCANDO® Adult GF Ocean 4kg، وهو طعام جاف للكلاب خالي من الحبوب ومصمم خصيصًا للكلاب البالغة. مصنوع من أسماك عالية الجودة مثل السلمون والرنجة، هذه الوجبة المغذية مليئة بالبروتين والدهون الصحية والعناصر الغذائية الأساسية، مما يعزز الصحة العامة والرفاهية. مثالية للكلاب البالغة التي تعاني من حساسية الحبوب أو الحساسية الغذائية، تقدم هذه التركيبة بديلاً لذيذًا وسهل الهضم لطعام الكلاب التقليدي. يوفر طعام BELCANDO® Adult GF Ocean أحماض أوميغا 3 وأوميغا 6 الدهنية، والتي تدعم صحة الجلد وفراء لامع ووظيفة إدراكية. مع مزيج من الخضروات والفواكه والأعشاب، تقدم هذه الوصفة الصحية وجبة متوازنة تساعد على الهضم وتعزز الطاقة وتدعم جهاز المناعة القوي. خالٍ من الحبوب والغلوتين والمواد المضافة الاصطناعية، يضمن هذا الطعام حصول كلبك على أفضل تغذية طبيعية. الميزات الرئيسية: 🐾 تركيبة خالية من الحبوب: مثالية للكلاب التي تعاني من حساسية الحبوب أو الحساسية، وتوفر وجبة صحية وسهلة الهضم. بروتين السمك الممتاز: السلمون والرنجة كمصدرين أساسيين للبروتين، مما يدعم نمو العضلات والطاقة ونظام المناعة الصحي. أحماض أوميجا الدهنية: تعمل أحماض أوميجا 3 وأوميجا 6 الدهنية على تعزيز صحة الفراء والبشرة الناعمة وتحسين وظائف المخ. مكونات قابلة للهضم ومفيدة: مزيج من الفواكه والخضروات والأعشاب لدعم الهضم الصحي وتوفير الفيتامينات والمعادن الأساسية. بدون إضافات صناعية: خالٍ من الألوان والنكهات والمواد الحافظة الصناعية، مما يضمن نظامًا غذائيًا طبيعيًا مليئًا بالعناصر الغذائية. لماذا تختار BELCANDO® Adult GF Ocean 4kg؟ 🐾 مثالي للكلاب البالغة التي تعاني من حساسية الحبوب أو تلك التي تتبع نظامًا غذائيًا خاليًا من الحبوب. يدعم العضلات القوية، والمعطف الصحي، والحيوية العامة مع بروتين السمك عالي الجودة. يعزز صحة الجلد، والفراء اللامع، ووظائف المخ مع أحماض أوميجا الدهنية. تركيبة كاملة ومتوازنة توفر كل ما يحتاجه كلبك البالغ من أجل صحة مثالية. امنح كلبك أفضل ما في المحيط مع وجبة BELCANDO® Adult GF Ocean 4kg - وجبة خالية من الحبوب لذيذة ومغذية تدعم صحة كلبك وطاقته وسعادته. نسبة البروتين الحيواني إلى البروتين الكلي: 75٪ (من أسماك البحر 65٪، من العوالق الحيوانية البحرية / الكريل 10٪)

item.g:title: IMac Dea 22 Double Bowl for Pet Red
item.g:description: IMac Dea Double Bowl for Pets The complete Dea feeding station, in one unit. The IMac Dea Double Bowl brings the clean Italian design and anti-slip feet of the Dea single bowl to a twin-bowl format — a dedicated food and water station that keeps everything organized, stable, and beautifully presented side by side. Available in Blue and Red, at the most accessible price point in the IMac double bowl range, the Dea Double Bowl is the practical, well-designed choice for cat owners and small dog households who want a proper feeding station without compromise. Why IMac Dea Double Bowl Is the Best Choice Anti-slip feet — the Dea difference — rubber anti-slip feet on the base keep the double bowl station firmly in place during feeding, eliminating the sliding and tipping that makes mealtime messier than it needs to be; a feature not found on all double bowl formats at this price point Two bowls, one station — food and water (or two food types) side by side in a single, stable unit; no more scattered bowls, no more searching for where the water bowl ended up Italian Dea design language — the same clean, rounded aesthetic that defines the Dea single bowl, Dea Slow Feeder, and Dea Food Dispenser; a visually cohesive feeding area for owners building a complete Dea setup Available in Blue and Red — two bold color options for personalization, aesthetic matching, or easy visual differentiation in multi-pet households Most accessible double bowl in the IMac range — the Dea Double Bowl delivers the quality and design of the IMac lineup at the most approachable price point in the double bowl category Encourages better hydration — having water consistently adjacent to food is one of the most effective ways to increase water intake in cats, who are naturally reluctant drinkers Suitable for both cats and dogs — a single product that works across species Product Details & Features The Dea Double Bowl combines two of the Dea range's defining characteristics — the clean Italian aesthetic and the anti-slip rubber feet — in a twin-bowl format that solves the most common daily feeding frustration: bowls that move. The anti-slip feet create enough friction against tile, hardwood, and laminate to keep the station stationary even during enthusiastic feeding, making mealtimes calmer and cleaner for both pet and owner. The twin-bowl format is the most practical feeding station configuration available — one bowl for food, one for water, always together, always in the same place. For cats in particular, the proximity of water to food is a meaningful factor in daily hydration. Cats are naturally reluctant drinkers who often ignore a water bowl placed across the room; having water immediately adjacent to their food source significantly increases the likelihood of regular drinking, supporting kidney health and urinary tract function over the long term. The Dea Double Bowl sits at the most accessible price point in the IMac double bowl range — 300 EGP less than the Diva Double Bowl — making it the natural entry point for owners who want the quality and design of the IMac lineup without the premium of the Diva range. For owners already using Dea single bowls, the Dea Slow Feeder, or the Dea Food Dispenser, it's also the obvious choice for maintaining visual consistency across the feeding area. item.g:description: IMac Double Feeder Ciottoli for Pets One station. Two bowls. Everything your pet needs, right where they need it. The IMac Double Feeder Ciottoli brings the same smooth, pebble-inspired Italian design of the single Ciottoli to a twin-bowl format — giving you a dedicated food and water station in a single, elegant unit that keeps feeding areas organized, tidy, and genuinely beautiful. Available in two sizes to suit cats and small-to-medium dogs, the Double Feeder Ciottoli is the upgrade that makes daily feeding simpler, cleaner, and more considered. Why IMac Double Feeder Ciottoli Is the Best Choice Two bowls, one station — the double format keeps food and water (or two food types) side by side in a single, stable unit, eliminating the clutter of separate bowls scattered across the floor Italian design heritage — IMac's signature pebble-inspired aesthetic brings a clean, considered look to the feeding area that single-purpose plastic bowls simply can't match Ideal food + water combination — the most practical use of the double format; having water always adjacent to food encourages better hydration habits, particularly in cats who are reluctant drinkers Stable, wide-base design — the joined double-bowl unit has a naturally wider footprint than two separate bowls, making it significantly more stable and resistant to tipping during enthusiastic feeding Smooth interior surfaces — no corners or crevices where food or water residue can accumulate; easy to clean thoroughly after every use Two sizes for cats and small-to-medium dogs — the 0.3+0.3L suits cats and toy breeds; the 0.6+0.6L handles small-to-medium dogs and larger cats comfortably Barcodes present on both variants ✓ — full product traceability Product Details & Features The Double Feeder Ciottoli solves one of the most common practical frustrations of pet ownership: the perpetually sliding, tipping, or scattered bowl situation. Cats in particular benefit from having water consistently available adjacent to their food, as proximity to the food source is one of the factors that influences how much water they drink. The double format is also useful for multi-food households: raw and dry, wet and dry, or two different food types for cats with specific dietary requirements. The two bowls are independent in use but unified in design, giving owners flexibility without sacrificing the clean, organized look of the feeding area. The Ciottoli design language — smooth curves, rounded edges, no sharp corners — carries through to the double format, making it as easy to clean as the single bowl and as comfortable to handle when moving or washing. How Bravecto Works Bravecto contains fluralaner, a powerful insecticide and acaricide that works systemically. After your dog eats the chew, fluralaner is absorbed into the bloodstream, distributed throughout the body, and remains at effective levels for 12 weeks. When fleas or ticks bite your dog, they ingest fluralaner, which attacks their nervous system, causing paralysis and death. Fleas and ticks are killed before they can reproduce or transmit diseases. Palatable Beef-Flavored Chew Unlike topical treatments that can be messy or difficult to apply, Bravecto is a tasty chew that most dogs eat willingly. The beef flavor makes administration easy, no mess or residue on fur, no waiting period before petting or swimming, and dogs actually enjoy taking their medicine. Treatment time becomes treat time. Veterinarian Recommended Bravecto is trusted by veterinarians worldwide for its proven efficacy and safety profile, extensive clinical testing, consistent results, and superior convenience. When your vet recommends flea and tick protection, Bravecto is often the first choice. Safe & Effective Bravecto has been extensively tested and proven safe when used as directed. It's suitable for dogs 6 months and older weighing 4.5-10kg, safe for breeding, pregnant, and lactating dogs, and compatible with most other medications. Always consult your veterinarian before use. item.g:description: Omni Guard Cat Worm X Worming Tablet 1 Tab – For Cats Up to 4kg Omni Guard Cat Worm X Worming Tablet is a broad-spectrum oral deworming treatment for cats, formulated with Pyrantel Embonate and Praziquantel to help control common intestinal worms. Each tablet is designed to treat a cat weighing approximately 4 kg , making dosage simple and convenient when used according to veterinary guidance. Active Ingredients Each tablet contains: Pyrantel Embonate – 230 mg Praziquantel – 20 mg The combination of these two active ingredients provides broad-spectrum activity against several common intestinal parasites in cats. What Does Omni Guard Cat Worm X Treat? Omni Guard Worm X is formulated to help control common intestinal worms, including: Roundworms Hookworms Tapeworms Regular parasite control is an important part of maintaining your cat’s general health and wellbeing. Product Benefits Broad-spectrum deworming: Targets several common types of intestinal worms. Dual-active formula: Combines Pyrantel Embonate and Praziquantel in one tablet. Convenient dosage: One tablet is designed for approximately 4 kg of body weight. Easy oral administration: Can be given directly by mouth or with a small amount of food. Suitable for routine parasite control: Can be used as part of a veterinarian-recommended deworming program. Dosage & Administration Recommended dosage: 1 tablet per 4 kg body weight The tablet may be administered directly into the mouth or mixed with a small amount of food. For cats weighing more or less than 4 kg, the appropriate dose should be determined according to body weight and product instructions. The frequency of deworming may vary depending on your cat’s age, lifestyle, parasite exposure, and health condition. Important Information Use according to the instructions on the product packaging and your veterinarian’s recommendations. Consult your veterinarian before use if your cat is: Very young Pregnant or nursing Underweight or unwell Taking other medications Known to have an existing medical condition Do not exceed the recommended dose. Keep out of reach of children and other animals. Storage Store according to the instructions stated on the original packaging and keep the tablet in its original pack until use.

item.g:title: IMac Food Dispenser Ciottoli for Pet 3L (29.5*23.5*29 Cm)
item.g:description: IMac Food Dispenser Ciottoli for Pets The feeding bowl that refills itself. The IMac Food Dispenser Ciottoli takes the elegant, pebble-inspired design of the Ciottoli range and elevates it into a fully functional gravity-fed dispenser — a reservoir unit that automatically releases food into the bowl as your pet eats, keeping the feeding station consistently stocked without constant manual refilling. Available in 1.5L and 3L capacities, it's the practical, beautiful solution for busy households, free-feeding routines, and owners who want the peace of mind that their pet always has food available — in a unit that looks as considered as everything else in their home. Why IMac Food Dispenser Ciottoli Is the Best Choice Gravity-fed auto-refill mechanism — as your pet eats from the bowl, food flows down from the reservoir automatically, maintaining a consistent level without any manual intervention between fills Italian Ciottoli design language — the same smooth, rounded pebble-inspired aesthetic that defines the Ciottoli bowl range, now in a full dispenser format; functional and beautiful in equal measure 1.5L and 3L reservoir capacities — the 1.5L suits cats and small dogs with 1–2 days of food between fills; the 3L handles larger dogs or multi-day free-feeding routines Reduces feeding frequency — ideal for busy owners, short trips away, or households where consistent manual feeding times are difficult to maintain Stable, wide-base design — the dispenser's low center of gravity and wide footprint keep it stable even during enthusiastic feeding Transparent reservoir — allows easy visual monitoring of food levels without opening or moving the unit Suitable for both cats and dogs — the dispenser format works across species and feeding styles Product Details & Features Gravity dispensers work on a simple, reliable principle: food is stored in an upper reservoir and flows down by gravity into the bowl below as the bowl empties. There are no batteries, no electronics, and no moving parts to maintain or replace — just a clean, passive mechanism that keeps the bowl consistently stocked as long as the reservoir has food in it. The IMac Ciottoli Dispenser applies this principle within the Ciottoli design framework — maintaining the smooth, rounded aesthetic of the bowl range while adding the practical functionality of a reservoir system. The result is a feeding station that looks like a considered design object rather than a utilitarian plastic container, and that performs reliably day after day without requiring attention. The 1.5L capacity (27×19×24cm) is well-suited to cats and small dogs — providing enough food for 1–2 days of free-feeding for most cats, or a full day's portion for small breeds. The 3L capacity (29.5×23.5×29cm) scales up for medium-to-large dogs or multi-cat households where a larger reserve between fills is more practical. The transparent reservoir section allows owners to monitor food levels at a glance — no need to open the unit or estimate by weight. When the reservoir runs low, simply open the top, refill, and the dispenser takes care of the rest. Key Features: Gravity-fed auto-refill mechanism — no batteries or electronics required Italian Ciottoli design — smooth, rounded pebble-inspired aesthetic 2 sizes: 1.5L and 3L reservoir capacity Transparent reservoir for easy food level monitoring Wide, stable base — anti-tip design Smooth interior surfaces — easy to clean Suitable for cats and dogs Ideal for free-feeding, busy households, and short trips

item.g:title: IMac Diva 22 Double Bowl for Pet 0.4+0.4L (32.5*16.5*6.3 Cm) Blue
item.g:description: IMac Diva Double Bowl for Pets Two bowls. One station. The Diva aesthetic. The IMac Diva Double Bowl brings the clean, considered design of the Diva range to a twin-bowl format — a dedicated food and water station that keeps everything organized, tidy, and beautifully presented in a single unit. At 0.4+0.4L per bowl, it's sized for cats and small-to-medium dogs, and available in Blue and Red to suit your home's color palette or to differentiate stations in multi-pet households. The practical upgrade that makes daily feeding simpler, cleaner, and more intentional. Why IMac Diva Double Bowl Is the Best Choice Two bowls, one station — food and water (or two food types) side by side in a single, stable unit; no more scattered bowls, no more sliding across the floor Diva design language — the same clean, Italian aesthetic that defines the Diva single bowl range, now in a twin-bowl format that maintains design consistency across your feeding area Available in Blue and Red — two bold color options for personalization, aesthetic matching, or easy visual differentiation in multi-pet households 0.4+0.4L capacity — perfectly sized for cats and small-to-medium dogs; enough for a full meal in one bowl and a generous water supply in the other Wide, stable footprint — the joined double-bowl unit has a naturally broader base than two separate bowls, making it significantly more resistant to tipping and sliding during feeding Smooth interior surfaces — no corners or crevices where food or water residue can accumulate; easy to clean thoroughly after every use Encourages better hydration — having water consistently adjacent to food is one of the most effective ways to increase water intake in cats, who are naturally reluctant drinkers Product Details & Features The Diva Double Bowl occupies a specific and practical niche in the IMac lineup. Where the single Diva Bowl offers a taller, more upright profile across four sizes, the Double Bowl takes a wider, lower-profile approach — a format that naturally suits the side-by-side twin-bowl configuration and keeps the overall station compact and stable on the floor. The 0.4+0.4L capacity per bowl is calibrated for cats and small-to-medium dogs — providing enough volume for a full meal in the food bowl and a meaningful water reserve in the water bowl, without the unit becoming unwieldy in smaller living spaces. For households with a single cat or a small dog, this is the ideal all-in-one feeding station size. The color choice — Blue or Red — adds the same personalization dimension that distinguishes the Diva range from the single-colorway Ciottoli Double Feeder. Whether you're matching a kitchen color scheme, differentiating between a cat's station and a dog's station, or simply choosing the color that feels right, the Diva Double Bowl gives you that flexibility without compromising on quality. item.g:title: Virbac Cat Urology Urinary WIB 1.5Kg
item.g:description: Virbac HPM — Cat Urology Urinary WIB | 400g / 1.5kg | Veterinary Clinical Dry Cat Food The urinary diet that protects against both crystal types. Virbac HPM Cat Urology Urinary WIB is a veterinary clinical nutrition dry cat food specifically formulated to support feline urinary health — preventing and managing the full spectrum of feline lower urinary tract disease (FLUTD), including struvite crystals, calcium oxalate crystals, idiopathic cystitis, and urethral plugs. The "WIB" designation reflects the most clinically sophisticated aspect of this formula — a precisely balanced mineral profile that simultaneously prevents struvite crystal formation and calcium oxalate crystal formation, the two most common urinary crystal types in cats. Most urinary diets address one crystal type effectively but inadvertently promote the other — acidifying diets dissolve struvite but increase calcium oxalate risk; alkalizing diets prevent calcium oxalate but promote struvite. Virbac HPM Urinary WIB navigates this clinical tension through precise mineral balance, controlled pH targeting, and high moisture encouragement — protecting the entire urinary tract without compromising against either crystal type. Optimal Urine pH Targeting — Targets a urine pH range that is unfavorable for both struvite (alkaline) and calcium oxalate (acidic) crystal formation — the narrow pH window where both crystal types are minimized. High Moisture Encouragement — Formulated to encourage water intake and increase urine volume — diluting the mineral concentrations that drive crystal formation and reducing urine specific gravity. Struvite Dissolution Support — The formula supports the dissolution of existing struvite crystals and prevents new struvite formation — the most common crystal type in young to middle-aged cats. Calcium Oxalate Prevention — Prevents calcium oxalate crystal formation — the most common crystal type in older cats and the crystal type that cannot be dissolved by diet alone. Idiopathic Cystitis Support — Stress-reducing and anti-inflammatory nutritional support for cats with feline idiopathic cystitis (FIC) — the most common cause of FLUTD in young cats. High Palatability — Clinical urinary diets must be consumed consistently — the Virbac HPM formula is formulated for high palatability to ensure consistent daily consumption. Two Sizes — 400g trial size for initial introduction; 1.5kg for ongoing management. Virbac HPM — Veterinary Expertise — From one of the world's leading animal health companies. Understanding the spectrum of FLUTD conditions explains why the WIB formula's comprehensive approach is clinically superior to single-indication urinary diets: Prevalence: FLUTD affects approximately 1–3% of cats annually Recurrence rates are high — 30–50% of cats experience recurrence within 12 months without dietary management Male cats are at significantly higher risk of urethral obstruction — a life-threatening emergency The FLUTD spectrum: Feline idiopathic cystitis (FIC) — 55–65% of FLUTD cases: FIC is the most common cause of FLUTD in cats under 10 years — characterized by bladder inflammation without an identifiable cause. Stress is the primary trigger — environmental changes, multi-cat households, indoor confinement, and routine disruption all increase FIC risk. Clinical signs include straining to urinate, blood in urine, frequent urination of small amounts, and urinating outside the litter box. Struvite crystals/uroliths — 15–20% of FLUTD cases: Struvite (magnesium ammonium phosphate) crystals form in alkaline urine with high magnesium and phosphorus concentrations. They are the most common crystal type in young to middle-aged cats and can be dissolved by dietary acidification and mineral restriction. Calcium oxalate crystals/uroliths — 10–15% of FLUTD cases: Calcium oxalate crystals form in acidic urine with high calcium and oxalate concentrations. What Does Omni Guard Dog Worm X Treat? Omni Guard Worm X for Dogs is formulated to help control common intestinal worms, including: Roundworms Hookworms Whipworms Tapeworms Regular deworming is an important part of maintaining your dog’s general health and reducing the risks associated with intestinal parasite infections. Product Benefits Triple-action formula: Combines three active ingredients for broad-spectrum parasite control. Broad worm coverage: Targets roundworms, hookworms, whipworms, and tapeworms. Convenient weight-based dosage: One tablet is designed for approximately 10 kg of body weight. Easy oral administration: Can be given directly by mouth, with or without food. Suitable for routine deworming: Can be included as part of a veterinarian-recommended parasite control program. Follow the deworming schedule recommended by your veterinarian. Treatment frequency may vary depending on your dog’s age, lifestyle, environment, parasite exposure, and general health. Important Information Always consult your veterinarian before use to confirm the appropriate dosage and deworming schedule for your dog. item.g:title: Perfecto Cat 10X Catsticks Mit Kalb & Truthahn 50g
item.g:description: Perfecto Cat — Catsticks Mit Kalb & Truthahn (Veal & Turkey) | 10 Sticks × 5g | 50g | Premium Cat Treat German precision. Premium proteins. Ten individual sticks. Perfecto Cat Catsticks Mit Kalb & Truthahn are premium German cat treat sticks made with veal and turkey — two of the most refined, lean, and palatable proteins available in the premium cat treat category. Each pack contains 10 individually portioned sticks of approximately 5g each — the perfect format for daily treating, training, and bonding, with the precise portion control that prevents overfeeding. Veal is the most tender, delicate expression of beef — lean, mild, and exceptionally digestible. Turkey is the leanest of the poultry proteins — rich in tryptophan, B vitamins, and the clean, mild flavor that cats find consistently appealing. Together, they create a dual-protein stick treat that is more nutritionally complete and more palatably interesting than single-protein alternatives — in the satisfying chewy stick format that cats love to hold, chew, and devour. German quality. Premium proteins. Ten sticks per pack. Why Perfecto Cat Catsticks Veal & Turkey Is The Best Choice Veal — The Most Tender Beef Protein — Veal is young beef — the most tender, delicate, and mildly flavored expression of beef protein, with exceptional digestibility and a refined flavor that cats find highly appealing. Turkey — The Leanest Poultry — Turkey is the leanest of the common poultry proteins — rich in tryptophan, B vitamins, and the clean, mild flavor that complements veal's delicate richness. Dual Premium Protein — Veal and turkey together provide a broader amino acid profile and more complete nutritional coverage than single-protein stick treats. 10 Individual Sticks — Pre-portioned into 10 individual sticks of ~5g each — perfect daily portion control, no measuring, no waste, no overfeeding. Stick Format — The elongated stick format that cats can hold between their paws and chew — engaging the natural holding and chewing behaviors that make stick treats one of the most satisfying treat formats. German Quality — Perfecto Cat — A trusted German pet food brand known for quality ingredients and precise formulation — the European quality standard applied to cat treats. Natural Taurine from Both Proteins — Both veal and turkey are natural taurine sources — the essential amino acid cats cannot synthesize. Chewy Texture — Satisfying chewing engagement that extends the treat experience and provides mild dental benefit. Novel Protein Variety — Veal is genuinely rare in cat treats — a novel protein that provides variety for cats who eat primarily chicken or seafood-based food. (Visual asset placement: lifestyle photo of a cat holding and chewing a Perfecto Cat stick, or flat-lay of the 10 sticks fanned out from the pack showing the individual portions.) Product Details & Features The Catstick Format — Why Sticks Work The cat stick format is one of the most engaging treat formats available — and it works because it aligns with natural feline feeding behaviors: Natural holding behavior: Cats in the wild hold prey with their front paws while eating — the stick format mimics this behavior, allowing cats to hold the stick between their paws and chew from one end. This holding and chewing behavior is deeply satisfying for cats — more engaging than simply eating a soft treat from a bowl. Chewing engagement: The firm, chewy texture of cat sticks requires sustained chewing — engaging the jaw muscles and providing a more physically satisfying treat experience than soft or liquid treats. Extended eating time: The chewing required for a stick treat extends the duration of the treat experience — cats spend more time engaged with the treat, increasing the perceived value and satisfaction. item.g:title: IMac Dea Slow Food for Pet Blue / 0.45L (20*5 Cm)
item.g:description: IMac Dea Slow Food Feeder for Pets Fast eaters are a common problem — and a genuinely risky one. Dogs and cats who eat too quickly swallow excess air alongside their food, leading to bloating, vomiting, regurgitation, and in severe cases, the life-threatening condition known as gastric dilatation-volvulus (GDV) in dogs. The IMac Dea Slow Food Feeder is designed to solve this at the source: a beautifully designed Italian slow feeder bowl with a patterned interior that naturally slows eating pace, improves digestion, and turns every meal into a more mindful, healthier experience. Available in Blue and Red, in two sizes for cats and dogs of all breeds. Why IMac Dea Slow Feeder Is the Best Choice Slows eating pace by design — the raised interior pattern forces pets to eat around obstacles, naturally reducing consumption speed by up to 10× compared to a standard flat bowl Reduces bloat and digestive discomfort — slower eating means less air swallowed, fewer episodes of vomiting or regurgitation, and significantly reduced risk of the bloating that fast eating causes Provides mental enrichment — working around the feeder's pattern engages a pet's problem-solving instincts, turning mealtime into a stimulating activity rather than a race to the bottom of the bowl Italian IMac design — the Dea's clean, considered aesthetic brings the same design quality as the rest of the IMac range to a functional health product; it looks as good as it performs Available in Blue and Red — two color options to suit your home's aesthetic or to differentiate bowls in multi-pet households Two sizes for cats and dogs — the 0.45L suits cats and small breeds; the 0.9L handles medium-to-large dogs comfortably Full SKU and barcode coverage on all variants ✓ — excellent product data quality Product Details & Features The science behind slow feeders is straightforward: when pets eat too fast, they consume food in large, rapid gulps that introduce significant amounts of air into the stomach. This air accumulation causes bloating, discomfort, and vomiting — and in large and deep-chested dog breeds, it can escalate to GDV, a surgical emergency. Slowing the eating pace eliminates the root cause of these issues without requiring any dietary changes or medication. The IMac Dea achieves this through its interior pattern — raised ridges and channels that divide the bowl's surface into sections, requiring pets to navigate around them to access their food. This simple mechanism is highly effective: most pets slow their eating pace significantly within the first few uses, and the behavioral change tends to persist even when they occasionally eat from a standard bowl. Beyond the health benefit, slow feeders provide a form of daily mental enrichment that is particularly valuable for indoor pets. The problem-solving engagement of working around the feeder's pattern activates the same instincts as foraging — a natural behavior that indoor cats and dogs rarely get to express. For pets who finish their meals in seconds and then spend the rest of the day looking for stimulation, a slow feeder transforms mealtime into a genuinely engaging activity. The Dea's design maintains IMac's commitment to aesthetic quality — a clean, rounded form in two bold colors that integrates naturally into any home environment without looking like a medical device. Key Features: Slow feeder interior pattern — reduces eating speed by up to 10× Reduces bloat, vomiting, and digestive discomfort Provides mental enrichment through foraging-style engagement Italian IMac design — clean, rounded aesthetic Available in Blue and Red 2 sizes: 0.45L and 0.9L Suitable for cats and dogs All variants have SKUs and barcodes ✓

item.g:title: Virbac Cortavance 76ml
item.g:description: Virbac Cortavance 76ml HYDROCORTISONE ACEPONATE TOPICAL SPRAY SOLUTION VETERINARY USE ONLY ■ DESCRIPTION: CORTAVANCETM Topical Spray is formulated with the active ingredient, hydrocortisone aceponate, 0.584 mg per mL in a suitable solvent, propylene glycol methyl ether for dermatologic use in dogs. Hydrocortisone aceponate is a dermocorticoid with a potent intrinsic glucocorticoid activity. ■ THERAPEUTIC CLASSIFICATION: Glucocorticoid ■ INDICATIONS: CORTAVANCETM Topical Spray is indicated for the symptomatic treatment of inflammatory and pruritic skin conditions in dogs. ■ DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION: Before administration, remove the cap and screw the pump spray on the bottle. The product is applied by activating the pump. Spray from a distance of about 10 cm above the area of skin to be treated. The recommended dose is 1.52 µg of hydrocortisone aceponate per cm2 of skin surface. This dose can be achieved with 2 pump spray activations over a 10 cm x 10 cm square surface area of skin. Leave treated area to dry. Presented as a volatile spray, this product does not require any massage. Care should be taken to avoid spraying in the eyes of the dog. Repeat treatment once daily for 7 consecutive days. If no improvement is seen within 7 days, treatment should be re-evaluated by the veterinarian. ■ CONTRAINDICATIONS: Do not use on cutaneous ulcers. ■ CAUTIONS: Total body surface treated with CORTAVANCETM Topical Spray should not exceed a surface corresponding to, for example, two flanks from the spine to mammary chains including the shoulders and thighs (1/3 of dog’s body). Avoid spraying in the eyes of the dog. In the case of concurrent microbial, fungal infections and flea infestations, dogs should receive appropriate treatment. If a favourable response does not occur promptly, treatment should be discontinued until the infection has been adequately controlled. Not for use in animals with hyperadrenocorticism (Cushing’s Disease). Since glucocorticoids are known to slow growth, use in young animals (under 7 months of age) is not recommended. Not for use in breeding, pregnant or lactating animals, as the safety of CORTAVANCETM Topical Spray has not been established. As with all glucocorticoids, the use of this product may adversely affect the Hypothalamic Pituitary Adrenal axis (HPA axis). Do not exceed the recommended dose or duration of treatment. Not for use in sick or debilitated animals. It is not recommended to apply other topical preparations simultaneously on the same lesion. ■ WARNINGS: Keep out of reach of children. In case of accidental contact with skin, it is recommended to wash thoroughly with water. Wash hands after use. Avoid contact with eyes. In case of accidental eye contact, rinse with abundant quantities of water. In case of eye irritation, seek medical advice. Avoid inhalation of CORTAVANCETM Topical Spray. In case of accidental ingestion, seek medical advice immediately and show the labelling to the physician. Spray in a well ventilated area. Flammable. Do not spray on naked flame or any incandescent material. ■ ADVERSE REACTIONS: Although not all adverse reactions are reported, the following adverse reaction information is based on voluntary post-approval drug experience reporting. It is generally recognized that this method of reporting results in significant under-reporting of adverse drug reactions. It should be noted that suspected ADRs listed here reflect reporting and not causality. Transient local reactions at the application site (erythema and/or pruritis) can occur in very rare cases (less than 1 in 10,000 animals). ■ CLINICAL PHARMACOLOGY: Hydrocortisone aceponate belongs to the diester class of glucocorticoids. Diesters are lipophilic substances of low plasma availability that effectively penetrate the skin to accumulate at the site of inflammation without significant systemic absorption. Once inside the skin, the diesters are transformed to deliver anti-inflammatory activity. In laboratory animals, hydrocortisone aceponate is eliminated like endogenous cortisol, through the urine and faeces. ■ SAFETY AND EFFICACY STUDY INFORMATION: The safety of CORTAVANCETM Topical Spray in dogs was demonstrated in two studies using 1X, 3X and 5X the therapeutic dose for 14 consecutive days in young dogs. Dogs with 3X and 5X the recommended dose for twice the recommended duration of treatment resulted in a reduced capacity for production of cortisol that was reversible within 7 to 9 weeks after the end of treatment. No adverse effects were seen during the clinical studies. Clinical efficacy of CORTAVANCETM Topical Spray has been demonstrated in a multi-site, controlled clinical field trial in dogs under normal conditions of use. In this study, 105 dogs (54 dogs treated with CORTAVANCETM Topical Spray; 51 dogs as positive control) representing 33 breeds were diagnosed with the following skin dermatoses: Skin Dermatoses % Flea Allergy Dermatitis ……………………………………. 29% Acute Moist Dermatitis (hot spot)
