item.g:title: VIRBAC Effitix Spot On Cane Small (4 - 10 Kg)
item.g:description: VIRBAC Effitix Spot-On for Dogs Small (4–10 kg) Small breeds are just as vulnerable to fleas and ticks as larger dogs, but they require treatments precisely dosed for their size. VIRBAC Effitix Spot-On Small is formulated for dogs weighing between 4 and 10 kg, providing a correctly measured monthly topical treatment that protects without overexposure. The combination of permethrin and fipronil works on the skin and coat to kill fleas, ticks, and lice, and to repel biting insects. For small dogs that spend time in gardens, parks, or with other animals, monthly Effitix application builds a reliable protective barrier that lasts through an entire month. Effitix is particularly convenient for owners who find oral tablet administration challenging with smaller, less cooperative dogs. Product Features Designed for small dogs weighing 4 to 10 kg Monthly spot-on application for sustained parasite control Kills fleas, ticks, and lice on contact Repels biting flies and sand flies Dual-action formula: permethrin and fipronil Correctly dosed for small dog body weight Protection lasts up to 4 weeks Trusted VIRBAC veterinary product Active Ingredients Permethrin and Fipronil – dual-action ectoparasitic protection. How to Apply Part the fur to expose the skin at the back of the neck, between the shoulder blades. Apply the entire contents of the pipette directly to the skin. Avoid contact with the dog's eyes or mouth. Keep children away until the site is dry. Dosing Guide Dog Weight Variant Application Interval 4 - 10 kg Effitix Small Every 4 weeks Not for use on cats. Do not bathe the dog for at least 48 hours before or after application for maximum efficacy. Store in original packaging below 25°C. item.g:title: IMac Diva Single Bowl for Pet Red / 2.8L (30.5*9.8 Cm)
item.g:description: IMac Diva Bowl for Pets The most versatile bowl in the IMac range. The Diva Bowl brings Italian design sensibility to a classic, upright bowl format — available in four sizes that span the full range from small cats and toy breeds to large and giant breed dogs, and in two bold colors that make it as much a design statement as a feeding solution. Clean lines, a taller profile, and the same commitment to quality that defines every IMac product — the Diva is the bowl for owners who want the right size, the right color, and the right aesthetic, all in one. Why IMac Diva Bowl Is the Best Choice Four sizes for every pet — from 0.40L for small cats and toy breeds to 2.8L for large and giant breed dogs, the Diva range covers the complete spectrum of pet sizes in a single, consistent design language Available in Blue and Red — two bold, distinct color options that allow personalization, aesthetic matching to your home, or easy visual differentiation between bowls in multi-pet households Taller, upright bowl profile — the Diva's more cylindrical form is particularly well-suited to pets who prefer a deeper bowl, and to longer-eared breeds where a taller, narrower bowl keeps ears out of the food Italian IMac design — the clean, considered aesthetic that IMac is known for, applied to a classic bowl format that works in any home environment Smooth interior surfaces — no corners or crevices where food residue can accumulate; easy to clean thoroughly after every use Stable base design — proportioned to stay in place during feeding without tipping or sliding Suitable for both cats and dogs — a single product line that works across species at every size Product Details & Features The Diva Bowl occupies a distinct position in the IMac lineup. Where the Ciottoli is defined by its flat, pebble-inspired form and the Dea by its rounded, low-profile design, the Diva brings a taller, more upright bowl profile that serves a different set of practical needs. The taller form is particularly valuable for certain breeds and feeding situations. Long-eared dogs — Cocker Spaniels, Basset Hounds, Beagles — benefit significantly from a taller, narrower bowl that keeps their ears elevated above the food surface, reducing the mess and hygiene issues that come with ears dragging through wet food. Cats who prefer to eat without their whiskers touching the bowl sides — a common sensitivity known as whisker fatigue — may also find the Diva's proportions more comfortable than very wide, shallow bowls. The four-size range is the most comprehensive in the IMac bowl lineup, making the Diva the natural choice for households with multiple pets of significantly different sizes, or for owners who want a single bowl design that can scale with a growing puppy from small to large. The two color options — Blue and Red — add a dimension of personalization that makes the Diva stand out in the IMac range. Whether you're matching a color scheme, differentiating between a food bowl and a water bowl, or simply choosing the color your cat or dog seems to prefer, the Diva gives you that choice without compromising on quality or design. Key Features: Italian IMac design — clean, upright bowl aesthetic Available in Blue and Red 4 sizes: 0.40L, 0.9L, 1.9L, 2.8L Taller, more cylindrical profile — ideal for long-eared breeds and whisker-sensitive cats Smooth interior surfaces — easy to clean Stable base — anti-tip design Suitable for cats and dogs of all sizes

item.g:description: Perfecto Cat — Catsticks Mit Lachs & Forelle (Salmon & Trout) | 10 Sticks × 5g | 50g | Premium Cat Treat The Omega-3 stick. Perfecto Cat Catsticks Mit Lachs & Forelle brings together two of the most Omega-3-rich cold-water fish available — salmon and trout — in the satisfying chewy stick format that cats hold, chew, and devour with natural instinct. Salmon is the most recognized premium fish in cat nutrition — celebrated for its exceptional EPA and DHA content, its rich, distinctive flavor, and its comprehensive coat, joint, and cognitive health benefits. Trout is the freshwater complement — a cold-water fish with a milder, cleaner flavor profile than salmon, equally rich in Omega-3, and genuinely rare in commercial cat treats. Trout — The Rare Freshwater Complement — Trout is genuinely rare in commercial cat treats — a cold-water freshwater fish with a milder, cleaner flavor than salmon and an equally impressive Omega-3 profile. Coat Health Focus — The dual Omega-3 from salmon and trout provides the most comprehensive coat health support available in a treat format — reducing shedding, improving coat gloss, and supporting skin barrier integrity. Anti-Inflammatory Benefit — EPA from both fish reduces the chronic low-level inflammation that contributes to skin conditions, joint deterioration, and immune dysregulation. Cognitive Support — DHA from both fish supports brain health and cognitive function — particularly valuable for aging cats. Natural Taurine from Both Fish — Both salmon and trout are natural taurine sources — the essential amino acid cats cannot synthesize. Vitamin D from Both Fish — Cold-water fish are among the richest natural dietary sources of Vitamin D — supporting calcium absorption, bone health, and immune function. 10 Individual Sticks — Pre-portioned into 10 individual sticks of ~5g each — perfect daily portion control. German Quality — Perfecto Cat — A trusted German pet food brand with rigorous quality standards. (Visual asset placement: lifestyle photo of a cat holding and chewing a Perfecto Cat salmon & trout stick, or flat-lay of the 10 sticks with the salmon and trout branding prominent.) Product Details & Features Salmon & Trout — The Cold-Water Fish Combination The combination of salmon and trout is the most nutritionally coherent dual-fish pairing available in cat treats — both are cold-water, oily fish from the salmonid family, sharing a nutritional profile that is exceptionally rich in Omega-3 fatty acids while offering complementary flavor profiles. What makes cold-water fish exceptional: Cold-water fish accumulate high concentrations of Omega-3 fatty acids (EPA and DHA) in their flesh as an adaptation to cold environments — the Omega-3 fatty acids lower the freezing point of cell membranes, keeping them fluid and functional in cold water. This biological adaptation produces the most Omega-3-rich flesh of any fish category — and it is the reason salmon, trout, mackerel, sardines, and herring are the most nutritionally valuable fish for both human and feline health. Salmon — The Premium Omega-3 Standard Salmon is the most recognized and celebrated fish in premium cat nutrition: Omega-3 content: Salmon is one of the richest natural sources of EPA and DHA available in any food: EPA (Eicosapentaenoic acid) — The most potent anti-inflammatory Omega-3. A key contributor to skin cell membrane integrity and coat gloss. Particularly important for cognitive function in aging cats. item.g:title: Nunbell Cat Toy Roll Around Flutter Bug Orange
item.g:description: It rolls. It flutters. It's completely irresistible. The Nunbell Roll Around Flutter Bug is a dual-action cat toy that combines an unpredictably rolling ball base with a fluttering bug attachment — triggering your cat's ground-chase and aerial-pounce instincts at the same time. The result is a toy that holds attention longer, encourages more active play, and delivers the kind of multi-sensory stimulation that keeps cats genuinely engaged. Available in Blue and Orange. Why the Nunbell Roll Around Flutter Bug Is the Best Choice Dual-Action Play — Rolling ball base + fluttering bug attachment = two hunting triggers in one toy Unpredictable Movement — The rolling motion mimics erratic prey behavior, keeping cats alert and engaged Fluttering Bug Element — The aerial flutter component invites swatting, pouncing, and batting — natural predatory behaviors cats need to express Sustained Engagement — Multi-sensory stimulation holds attention far longer than single-action toys Encourages Independent Play — Keeps cats active and entertained without requiring your constant involvement Trusted Nunbell Brand — Consistent quality and durability from a recognized pet care name Available in Blue & Orange — Two bold, high-visibility colors that cats can track easily during play Product Details & Features The Roll Around Flutter Bug is engineered around how cats actually hunt. In the wild, cats don't just chase — they stalk, swipe, pounce, and bat at prey that moves unpredictably across multiple planes. This toy replicates that experience: the rolling ball base moves across the floor in erratic, prey-like patterns while the fluttering bug attachment moves through the air above it, creating a layered play experience that engages your cat's full hunting sequence. This kind of multi-stimulus play is particularly valuable for indoor cats, who don't have access to the natural hunting opportunities that outdoor cats experience. Regular active play sessions reduce boredom, prevent stress-related behaviors, and support healthy weight and muscle tone. The Nunbell build quality ensures the toy holds up through enthusiastic daily play sessions without the bug attachment detaching or the rolling mechanism losing its responsiveness. Key Features: Rolling ball base — unpredictable, prey-like ground movement Fluttering bug attachment — aerial stimulus for swatting and pouncing Dual-action design — engages ground-chase and aerial-hunt instincts simultaneously Sustained engagement — multi-sensory play holds attention longer Encourages independent, self-directed play Suitable for kittens and adult cats Durable Nunbell construction — built for daily active play Available in Blue and Orange Specifications Detail Info Brand Nunbell Toy Type Roll Around Flutter Bug Play Elements Rolling ball base + fluttering bug attachment Available Colors Blue, Orange Suitable For Kittens & Adult Cats Best For Independent play, active stimulation, indoor cats

item.g:description: IMac Feeder Ciottoli for Pets A feeding bowl that's as considered in its design as it is practical in its use. The IMac Ciottoli Feeder takes its name from the Italian word for pebbles — a nod to the smooth, rounded aesthetic that defines its form. Designed in Italy with the attention to detail that Italian pet accessories are known for, the Ciottoli is a feeder that looks as good on your floor as it performs at every meal. Available in four sizes from 0.3L to 2L, it covers the full range from small cats and toy breeds to large dogs — one design, every pet. Why IMac Ciottoli Is the Best Choice Italian design heritage — IMac is an Italian brand with a strong reputation for combining functional pet accessories with the kind of clean, considered aesthetic that elevates everyday objects; the Ciottoli reflects that philosophy in every curve Four sizes for every pet — from 0.3L for small cats and toy breeds to 2L for large and giant breed dogs, the Ciottoli range covers the full spectrum of pet sizes in a single, consistent design language Smooth, rounded form — the pebble-inspired shape has no sharp edges or corners, making it comfortable to place, easy to move, and safe around pets and children Easy to clean — the smooth interior surface and simple form factor make the Ciottoli straightforward to wash by hand or in the dishwasher, maintaining hygiene with minimal effort Stable, low-profile design — the wide, flat base keeps the bowl stable during feeding, reducing tipping and the mess that comes with it Suitable for both cats and dogs — a single product that works across species, making it the practical choice for multi-pet households Product Details & Features The IMac Ciottoli Feeder is designed around the principle that a feeding bowl should be simple, beautiful, and completely reliable. The rounded, pebble-inspired form is not just an aesthetic choice — it also serves a functional purpose. The smooth, continuous interior surface has no corners or crevices where food residue can accumulate, making cleaning thorough and effortless. The wide, stable base prevents the tipping and sliding that narrower or lighter bowls are prone to, keeping feeding areas cleaner and mealtimes calmer. The four-size range is designed to scale appropriately with pet size — not just in capacity, but in the physical dimensions of the bowl itself. A 0.3L bowl sized for a small cat is proportionally different from a 2L bowl for a large dog, ensuring that the eating experience is comfortable and natural for pets at every size. item.g:description: The Virbac® Cat Dry Food Weight Loss & Diabetes 1.5kg has a number of health benefits, including: Rapid weight loss: The diet is low in energy density, which means that it provides fewer calories per gram of food. This can help cats to lose weight quickly and safely. Management of diabetes mellitus: The diet is low in carbohydrates, which can help to regulate blood sugar levels in cats with diabetes. Joint support: The diet contains glucosamine and chondroitin sulfate, which can help to support joint health in cats. Lean mass maintenance: The diet is high in protein, which can help to maintain lean mass during weight loss. Satiety: The diet contains fibers and proteins, which can help to promote satiety and make cats feel full after eating. Low glycemic index: The diet has a low glycemic index, which means that it does not cause a sharp spike in blood sugar levels after eating. This can be helpful for cats with diabetes or other health conditions that are affected by blood sugar levels. It is important to note that this diet is not a cure for diabetes or any other health condition. It is a dietary supplement that can help to manage these conditions and improve your cat's quality of life. If you are considering using this diet for your cat, it is important to talk to your veterinarian first. They can help you determine if this diet is right for your cat and can provide you with more information about how to use it safely.

item.g:title: Nunbell Pet Slicker Grooming Brush for Cats & Dogs
item.g:description: Nunbell Pet Slicker Grooming Brush for Cats & Dogs Make regular grooming easier with the Nunbell Pet Slicker Grooming Brush , designed to help remove loose hair and keep your pet’s coat neat and manageable. The compact palm-style design gives you better control while brushing, making it suitable for routine grooming sessions with both cats and dogs. Its multiple grooming pins help work through the coat and collect loose fur before it ends up around your home. Product Features Helps remove loose hair: Collects shedding fur during regular grooming. Slicker-style grooming surface: Multiple pins help work through the coat efficiently. For cats & dogs: Suitable for regular coat care for different pets. Helps manage light tangles: Useful for gently working through minor knots and messy areas. Compact palm design: Easy to hold and control during grooming. Regular coat maintenance: Helps keep the coat looking cleaner, neater, and well groomed. Useful during shedding: A practical grooming tool for collecting loose hair before it reaches furniture and clothes. Reusable: Simply remove collected fur from the brush after each grooming session. Suitable For The Nunbell Pet Grooming Brush can be used as part of the regular grooming routine for: Cats Dogs Short-haired pets Medium-haired pets Pets that shed regularly For pets with very long, thick, or heavily tangled coats, additional grooming tools may be required. Why Regular Brushing Matters Regular brushing helps remove loose and dead hair while keeping your pet’s coat more manageable. It also gives pet owners an opportunity to check the coat and skin during grooming for unusual tangles, dirt, or other changes that may need attention. How to Use Make sure your pet’s coat is dry and reasonably free from heavy knots. Brush gently in the direction of hair growth. Use short, controlled strokes without applying excessive pressure. Pay extra attention to areas where loose hair commonly collects. Remove trapped fur from the brush after grooming. Clean the brush when needed and allow it to dry before storage. Grooming Tips Introduce the brush gradually if your pet is not used to grooming. Avoid applying heavy pressure, particularly over sensitive areas, joints, or thin skin. Do not use the brush over wounds, irritated skin, or inflamed areas. item.g:title: Virbac Cat Urology Dissolution& Prevention 1.5Kg
item.g:description: Virbac HPM — Cat Urology Dissolution & Prevention | 1.5kg | Veterinary Clinical Dry Cat Food Dissolve existing struvite. Prevent recurrence. Virbac HPM Cat Urology Dissolution & Prevention is a veterinary clinical nutrition dry cat food specifically formulated for the active dissolution of struvite crystals and uroliths, and the long-term prevention of struvite recurrence. Where the Virbac HPM Urinary WIB formula provides balanced dual protection against both struvite and calcium oxalate crystals, the Dissolution & Prevention formula is a struvite-targeted clinical diet — more aggressively formulated for urine acidification and mineral restriction to actively dissolve existing struvite deposits and prevent new struvite formation. This is the formula prescribed when struvite crystals have been confirmed by urinalysis or imaging — the clinical diet that works actively to resolve the existing crystal burden while simultaneously preventing recurrence. Struvite is the most common urinary crystal type in cats — and dietary dissolution is the preferred first-line treatment for struvite uroliths, avoiding the need for surgical removal in most cases. 1.5kg — the struvite dissolution and prevention diet that resolves the problem and keeps it resolved. Why Virbac HPM Cat Urology Dissolution & Prevention Is The Best Choice Active Struvite Dissolution — Formulated to actively dissolve existing struvite crystals and uroliths through urine acidification and mineral restriction — the dietary alternative to surgical urolith removal. Struvite Prevention — Maintains the urinary environment that prevents new struvite crystal formation after dissolution is complete — for long-term recurrence prevention. Urine Acidification — Targets a urine pH that dissolves struvite (which requires alkaline conditions to form and acidic conditions to dissolve) — the primary mechanism of dietary struvite dissolution. Magnesium & Phosphorus Restriction — Struvite is composed of magnesium ammonium phosphate — restricting these minerals reduces the substrate available for crystal formation. High Moisture Encouragement — Increasing urine volume dilutes mineral concentrations and flushes the urinary tract — supporting both dissolution and prevention. Struvite-Confirmed Indication — The appropriate choice when struvite crystals have been confirmed by veterinary urinalysis or imaging — more targeted than the WIB formula for confirmed struvite cases. Dissolution Without Surgery — Dietary struvite dissolution avoids the need for surgical cystotomy in most cases — a significant benefit for cat owners and cats alike. High Palatability — Clinical urinary diets must be consumed consistently for dissolution to occur — the Virbac HPM formula is formulated for high palatability. Virbac HPM — Veterinary Expertise — From one of the world's leading animal health companies. 1.5kg — The ongoing management size for the dissolution and prevention program. (Visual asset placement: flat-lay of the Virbac HPM Dissolution & Prevention bag with the clinical branding prominent, or lifestyle photo of a comfortable, healthy cat — communicating the urinary health the clinical diet restores.) Product Details & Features Struvite — The Most Common Feline Urinary Crystal Struvite (magnesium ammonium phosphate, MgNH₄PO₄·6H₂O) is the most common urinary crystal type in cats — accounting for approximately 40–50% of feline uroliths submitted for analysis. Understanding struvite formation and dissolution explains why the Dissolution & Prevention formula works: How struvite forms: Struvite crystals form when urine contains: Alkaline pH (>7.0) — Struvite is insoluble in alkaline urine and precipitates readily High magnesium concentration — Magnesium is a structural component of struvite High ammonium concentration — Ammonium (from protein metabolism) is a structural component of struvite High phosphate concentration — Phosphate is a structural component of struvite Concentrated urine — High urine specific gravity increases the concentration of all crystal-forming minerals Risk factors for struvite formation: Urinary tract infection (UTI) — Urease-producing bacteria alkalinize urine and increase ammonium — the most common cause of struvite in dogs (less common in cats) Alkaline diet — High-carbohydrate, plant-protein-heavy diets tend to alkalinize urine Concentrated urine — Inadequate water intake Female cats — Wider urethra allows bacteria to ascend more easily (UTI-associated struvite) How struvite dissolves: Struvite is soluble in acidic urine — reducing urine pH below 6.5 causes existing struvite crystals to dissolve. This is the mechanism of dietary struvite dissolution: The Dissolution & Prevention diet acidifies urine to pH 6.0–6.5 Existing struvite crystals dissolve in the acidic urine Dissolved minerals are excreted in the urine The crystal burden is progressively reduced over 4–12 weeks The diet is continued to prevent recurrence The Dissolution & Prevention Formula — Clinical

item.g:title: Virbac Dog Hypoallergy With Hydrolysed Fish Protein 3KG
item.g:description: Virbac HPM — Dog Hypoallergy With Hydrolysed Fish Protein | 3kg | Veterinary Clinical Dry Dog Food The gold standard for canine food allergy management. Virbac HPM Dog Hypoallergy With Hydrolysed Fish Protein is a veterinary clinical nutrition dry dog food formulated using hydrolysed fish protein — the most scientifically validated approach to eliminating food allergy reactions in dogs. Hydrolysis is the process of breaking protein molecules into fragments so small that the immune system can no longer recognize and react to them — eliminating the allergenic trigger at the molecular level rather than simply avoiding common allergens. This is not a "grain-free" or "limited ingredient" commercial food — it is a genuine clinical hypoallergenic diet, developed by Virbac's veterinary nutritionists and validated through clinical research, for dogs with confirmed or suspected food allergies and food intolerances. For dogs who have failed standard elimination diets, who react to multiple protein sources, or who require the most rigorous hypoallergenic formulation available — Virbac HPM Hypoallergy is the clinical answer. 3kg of veterinary-grade hypoallergenic nutrition — the diet that eliminates the reaction at its source. Why Virbac HPM Dog Hypoallergy Hydrolysed Fish Protein Is The Best Choice Hydrolysed Fish Protein — The Gold Standard — Protein hydrolysis breaks fish protein into peptide fragments below the molecular weight threshold that triggers immune recognition — eliminating the allergenic response at the molecular level. True Hypoallergenic Formulation — Not a "limited ingredient" or "grain-free" commercial food — a genuine veterinary clinical hypoallergenic diet formulated to the most rigorous hypoallergenic standards. Fish as the Hydrolysed Protein Source — Fish is selected as the hydrolysis substrate for its high digestibility, complete amino acid profile, and status as a novel protein for most dogs who have been fed chicken or beef-based diets. Elimination Diet Standard — Suitable for use as the elimination diet in food allergy diagnosis protocols — the clinical standard for identifying food allergy triggers. Long-Term Management Diet — Suitable for long-term feeding as the primary diet for dogs with confirmed food allergies — providing complete and balanced nutrition without allergenic triggers. Virbac HPM — Veterinary Expertise — From one of the world's leading animal health companies — the same scientific rigor applied to Virbac's pharmaceutical products, applied to clinical nutrition. Complete & Balanced — Provides complete and balanced nutrition for adult dogs — all essential nutrients in appropriate proportions despite the clinical formulation. Addresses Multiple Allergy Manifestations — Suitable for food allergy presenting as skin conditions (atopic dermatitis, pruritus), gastrointestinal symptoms (diarrhea, vomiting), or both. 3kg Clinical Pack — A practical clinical diet size for ongoing management. (Visual asset placement: flat-lay of the Virbac HPM Hypoallergy bag with the clinical branding prominent, or lifestyle photo of a comfortable, itch-free dog — communicating the relief that the hypoallergenic diet provides.) Product Details & Features Understanding Canine Food Allergy — The Problem This Diet Solves Food allergy in dogs is an immune-mediated adverse reaction to one or more dietary proteins — the immune system incorrectly identifies a food protein as a threat and mounts an inflammatory response. Understanding the mechanism explains why hydrolysed protein is the most effective solution: How food allergy develops: Sensitization — The dog is repeatedly exposed to a dietary protein (most commonly chicken, beef, dairy, wheat, or egg) Immune recognition — The immune system produces IgE antibodies specific to that protein Reaction — On subsequent exposure, the protein binds to IgE antibodies on mast cells — triggering the release of histamine and other inflammatory mediators Symptoms — The inflammatory response produces the clinical signs of food allergy Common food allergy symptoms in dogs: Skin — Pruritus (itching), erythema (redness), papules, alopecia (hair loss), recurrent ear infections, paw licking and chewing Gastrointestinal — Chronic diarrhea, vomiting, flatulence, increased bowel movement frequency Combined — Many dogs present with both skin and gastrointestinal symptoms simultaneously Why standard elimination diets often fail: Standard "limited ingredient" or "novel protein" commercial diets frequently fail to resolve food allergy because: Cross-contamination during manufacturing introduces trace amounts of common allergens The "novel" protein may not be truly novel for the individual dog Intact proteins — even from novel sources — can still trigger immune recognition in sensitized dogs Why Hydrolysed Protein Is the Gold Standard Hydrolysis is the process of breaking protein molecules into smaller fragments (peptides) using enzymes or acid — and it is the most scientifically vali

item.g:title: Virbac EPIOTIC for Dog & Cat SIS 125ML VBI
item.g:description: The veterinary standard for ear hygiene. Virbac Epiotic is the world's most widely used veterinary ear cleaning solution — a clinically proven, non-irritating ear cleaner specifically formulated to clean, dry, deodorize, and maintain the healthy ear environment of dogs and cats. Epiotic is not a treatment for ear infections — it is the preventive and maintenance ear cleaner that removes the wax, debris, and moisture that create the conditions for otitis externa (ear infection) to develop. Regular ear cleaning with Epiotic is the single most effective preventive measure for otitis externa — the most common ear condition in dogs and one of the most frequent reasons for veterinary consultation. Epiotic's unique formulation combines salicylic acid (ceruminolytic — dissolves ear wax), a monosaccharide solution (creates an osmotic environment that draws moisture from the ear canal), and EDTA-Tris (antimicrobial potentiator) — working together to clean the ear canal, reduce moisture, acidify the ear environment, and create conditions unfavorable for bacterial and yeast growth. Gentle enough for regular weekly use. Effective enough to be the ear cleaner that veterinary dermatologists recommend worldwide. 125ml — the ear hygiene solution that prevents the problem before it starts. Why Virbac Epiotic Is The Best Choice The World's Most Widely Used Veterinary Ear Cleaner — Epiotic is the ear cleaning solution that veterinary dermatologists recommend and prescribe more than any other — the clinical gold standard for ear hygiene in dogs and cats. Ceruminolytic Action — Salicylic acid dissolves and loosens ear wax (cerumen) — allowing it to be flushed out of the ear canal rather than accumulating and creating a substrate for infection. Drying Effect — The monosaccharide solution creates an osmotic environment that draws moisture from the ear canal — reducing the humidity that bacteria and yeast require to thrive. Acidifying Effect — Epiotic acidifies the ear canal environment — creating a pH that is unfavorable for the growth of the bacteria and yeast most commonly responsible for otitis externa. EDTA-Tris — Antimicrobial Potentiator — Enhances the antimicrobial effect of the acidified environment — disrupting bacterial cell walls and increasing susceptibility to the ear's natural defenses. Non-Irritating — Gentle enough for regular weekly use — does not irritate the sensitive skin of the ear canal even with frequent application. Deodorizing — Removes the organic debris and microbial metabolites that produce the characteristic unpleasant odor of dirty or infected ears. Otitis Prevention — Regular use prevents the wax accumulation, moisture retention, and pH shift that create the conditions for otitis externa to develop. For Dogs & Cats — Formulated for use in both species — a versatile veterinary ear cleaner for multi-pet households. Virbac — Veterinary Expertise — From one of the world's leading animal health companies. 125ml — A practical size for regular maintenance ear cleaning. (Visual asset placement: lifestyle photo of a dog or cat having its ears cleaned with Epiotic — communicating the ease and gentleness of the cleaning process — or flat-lay of the Epiotic bottle with the clinical branding prominent.) Product Details & Features Understanding Otitis Externa — The Problem Epiotic Prevents Otitis externa (inflammation and infection of the external ear canal) is one of the most common conditions in dogs — accounting for approximately 10–20% of all veterinary consultations. Understanding how otitis develops explains why regular ear cleaning with Epiotic is the most effective preventive measure: The ear canal environment: The canine and feline ear canal is L-shaped — with a vertical canal and a horizontal canal leading to the eardrum. This anatomy: Traps moisture, wax, and debris — particularly in dogs with floppy ears or narrow canals Creates a warm, dark, humid environment — ideal for bacterial and yeast growth Makes self-cleaning difficult — the dog cannot effectively remove accumulated debris The otitis development cascade: Predisposing factors — Floppy ears, narrow canals, excessive hair in the canal, swimming, allergies, or hormonal disorders create conditions that favor otitis Primary factors — Allergies (the most common), foreign bodies, parasites (ear mites), or keratinization disorders initiate the inflammatory process Secondary factors — Bacteria ( Staphylococcus , Pseudomonas ) and yeast ( Malassezia ) colonize the inflamed ear canal — converting inflammation into infection Perpetuating factors — Chronic changes to the ear canal (thickening, stenosis, calcification) make the condition self-perpetuating Where Epiotic intervenes: Epiotic intervenes at the earliest stage — removing the wax, debris, and moisture that create the conditions for the otitis cascade to begin.
